prior_year_events.event_name: Favourable settlements on 2014 and prior years
prior_year_events.impact_description: Reduction in the 2014 and prior years' liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2017, producing a profit arising from the reinsurance to close of GBP 13.8m before expenses and investment return.

named_events.loss_description: The current incurred loss from the hurricanes of late 2017 to the whole account is a gross loss of US$6.5 million and a net amount of US$4.6 million.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (31 Dec 2016) was GBP 271.047m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a small net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 3.0m (1.1% of opening reserves), driven mainly by adverse movement in the 2015 underwriting year which outweighed releases in older years (notably favourable settlements on 2014 and prior years). The report also records material 2017 catastrophe activity (hurricanes and flooding) affecting the 2017 year. Per-LOB reported movements (net of reinsurance) show a mix of increases and releases across Accident & Health, Property, Casualty and reinsurance lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 63) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2016,2017) per standard methodology. The detailed per-LOB movements shown in the notes are reported net of reinsurance; gross per-LOB reserve movements were not provided. The 'Significant movements' table on page 63 reports net (after reinsurance) movements; those net figures were used for LOB movement entries and flagged accordingly.
